name: NGC 6796, SN 2017ixv field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6796, a galaxy that hosted the broad-lined Type Ic supernova SN 2017ixv, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2017ixv-hubble
story: SN 2017ixv, a broad-lined Type Ic supernova, went off in this galaxy. Hubble returned to the site for a late look after the blast had faded.

claims.text: SN 2017ixv was a Type Ic-BL supernova in NGC 6796, imaged in GO-16179
Hubble program 16179 imaged the site of SN 2017ixv
